verdict.rationale: The Literature agent searches a corpus of 175M+ papers, clinical trials, and patents rather than the open web. The docs say it natively understands citation graphs, journal quality, and clinical trial data, and returns cited answers traceable to specific literature passages. It is also exposed via the API as JobNames.LITERATURE / LITERATURE_HIGH. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of corpus coverage and retrieval quality; all evidence is vendor documentation.
